purpose: Full security audit for the vfs-py 0.1.0a1 release (context/standards/release.md step 3).

budget.raise_note: Raised from 30 to 65 on 2026-11-07 by the developer (chose "Raise budget, full") after wave 1 produced 15 candidates. Raised again from 65 to 75 after critic c02 opened a third wave, to keep the standard profile complete as the developer chose; disclosed to the developer. Raised again from 75 to 90 on 2026-11-07 by the developer (chose "Raise to ~90, hunt it") after critic c05 opened wave 6.

agent_model: opus (every delegated agent, at the developer's request)

sandbox.controls: sandbox-exec: all network denied including loopback; file writes only under the agent's scratch/. env -i equivalent: HOME, TMPDIR, PATH, LANG, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX only. RLIMIT_CPU 60s, RLIMIT_FSIZE 64MiB, RLIMIT_NPROC 256, 120s wall clock (SIGKILL). Memory: macOS refuses RLIMIT_AS/DATA/RSS, so a trusted parent watchdog samples process-group RSS every 50ms and SIGKILLs the group above 2GiB (self-test: 3GiB allocation killed at 2.6GiB).
sandbox.self_test: 2026-11-07: env allowlist, repo write blocked, external network blocked, memory watchdog kill, CPU limit set — all passed.

promotion.self_test: 2026-11-07: regular file promoted; symlink, hard link, traversal refused.
